payload.entry: Flag artifact_link_derivation was retired by epic phase sase-tw.14 (commit 7f6f936de): the Off branch is gone, derivation is unconditional at every call site, and the registry entry and schema property were removed. Verified on master 7f6f936de: no artifact_link_derivation member in src/sase/feature_flags/registry.py or src/sase/config/sase.schema.json, no artifact_link_derivation_enabled() gate left in src/, and just lint (including tools/check_feature_flags) exits 0. That phase's launch instruction allowed it to close only its own bead, so it left this as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; closed here by the sase-tw land agent.
